final_draft.answer: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
final_draft.note: I used the approved answer for control CC6.2 word for word. It is owned by security@harborlight.example and is valid until 2027-11-18. Access Control Policy section 4.3 backs it up: access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day. I did not check this against a live setting, because none of the available checks covers removing access for leavers.

policy:9a5ed387-ce91-4753-8a3c-6ae231fc1: Every workforce member has a named account. Shared accounts are not permitted.
answer:27b0a41d-6ae8-453a-813d-e7cab0e2b: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
answer:98e93990-6998-4fab-bf01-ad647f639: Yes. Multi-factor authentication is required for all employee accounts through our identity provider. SMS is not an accepted factor.
